title: Sage area_map record
description: A area_map record (AreaMapRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another area_map record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

picture.description: The picture of the ground the map shows under its markers; empty: none. A texture path. (AssetPath)

from.description: The picture's top left (north-west) corner: absolute X and Z. Unit: m. (Vector2, default [0,0])

to.description: The picture's bottom right (south-east) corner: absolute X and Z. Unit: m. (Vector2, default [0,0])

fog.description: Where the player has not been is hidden under fog until they come near it (default true) (bool, default true)

cell.description: The side of one square of fog. Unit: m. At least 1. (float, default 16)

reveal.description: How far round the player the fog lifts. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 24)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
